اسلنطعن (form IIIq)
# اِسْلَنْطَعْنَ (islanṭaʕna) /is.lan.tˤaʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْلَنْطَعَ (islanṭaʕa)
# اِسْلَنْطِعْنَ (islanṭiʕna) /is.lan.tˤiʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْلَنْطَعَ (islanṭaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
